Firstly, just halving the number of legal immigrants into this country we will preserve the white majority for the foreseeable future. Pew research wrote that by 2050 if current trends hold the population of the United states is projected to be 438 million people. 82% of the growth will be from immigration or the descendants of immigrants after 2005. As I am sure we are all aware that will mean White Americans will be down to 47% of the population in 2050. How does the RAISE act change the math? Conveniently Pew research center does projections to see how the numbers change if immigration policy changes. They estimated that if immigration were to be 50% lower than current levels, US population will be 384 million in 2050 with 71% of the population increase being immigrants or the children of immigrants. What that will mean is that Whites will be 54% of the population in 2050, or 207 million out of 384 million. So just by cutting the number of legal immigrants in half our outlook becomes much much better. Those estimates still assume that illegal immigration and birth rates stay the same, lowering either of those makes it even better.

The Raise act will accomplish one of those two goals by preferring immigrant groups that have lower birth rates. Pew's projections for 50% lower immigration rates, that the RAISE act would accomplish, use the same birth rates as every other projection. If Latin immigration is curtailed it becomes very unlikely that whites will lose their demographic majority. There simply are not enough Blacks and Hispanics here to out breed us and Asians will not be able to do it. Additionally, Hispanic fertility drops significantly after the first immigrant generation, so if no new ones are coming in breeding like rabbits their overall fertility rate will fall, further securing our demographic majority.

If anything it is likely that White immigration will increase because more of them speak English, giving them an edge against Asians. We won't be adding more Asians we will just be getting rid of Mexicans and Africans immigration. The RAISE act will not increase Asian immigration in fact it will decrease it in the long run. For the first member of a family that comes to the US, to obtain a green card, they will need to be able to get a job that pays at least the median income for the given field with more points being award the higher the wage is above the median.
